title: CurseCore Field: First Steps
summary: Learn Echo Rot and diagnostics before treating curses as ordinary potion effects.

blocks.title: Read The Symptom
blocks.body: Start with Echo Rot as a live test curse. Watch stage, timer, and feedback instead of guessing from damage alone.

blocks.title: Use Diagnostics
blocks.body: Curse diagnostic slips and Lens scans should help identify whether a curse is active, minor, reduced, or cleansed.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A clean first CurseCore win is applying Echo Rot, seeing state persist, and cleansing a minor curse without losing ritual ingredients on failure.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
